goals.title: High Score: 15,000
goals.description: Land 15,000 points in one 2-minute run on the Hills.

goals.title: Collect S-K-A-T-E
goals.description: S tops Hillcrest Drive, K is over a back yard fence, A rides the ditch, T floats over the spillway quarter pipe, E waits at the bottom of Canyon Road.

goals.title: Five Slices
goals.description: Grab the five pizza slices: two in Summit Court, one on the terrace wall, one over the funbox, one on the overlook rail.

goals.title: Pool Hopper
goals.description: Grab the 1, 2 and 3 coins over the three back yard pools on Pool Row.

goals.title: Secret Tape
goals.description: Find the tape in a hidden back yard pool somewhere near the park.

goals.title: Gap Hunter: 10 gaps
goals.description: Find 10 different gaps around the Hills.

goals.title: Million Dollar Grind
goals.description: Grind for 5 seconds in one go (the overlook rail is long).
